plain: The violent seizure of property; plunder

webster.text: The act of plundering; the seizing and carrying away of things by force.

example.quote: and displays in the most captivating manner the charming Pictures of Candour frankness & sincerity while it is rioting in rapine and Insolence:
example.cite: John Adams, To the Officers of the First Brigade of the Third Division of the Militia of Massachusetts, Oct. 11, 1798
